problems.answer: higher, longer, bigger, more interesting, more beautiful

problems.condition: Unit 1, Step 8, упр. 5, с. 41. Составь вопросы к ответам (A–D).
steps: A) Do you often go abroad? Do you travel in winter? Does Alice like to visit her grandparents? Does Bob often go to museums?
B) Did Tom write a letter yesterday? Did Bob eat his lunch? Did you do your room? Did Betty wash up after breakfast?
C) Is Moscow the capital of Russia? Are they abroad now? Was John in Canada in May? Were the Barkers in Scotland last summer?
D) Are there a lot of people? Is there a cinema in your town? Was there a bus stop in your street last year? Were there many cars in the street?
problems.answer: Do / Does, Did, Is / Are / Was / Were, Is there / Are there

problems.condition: Unit 1, Step 10, упр. 1, с. 46. Прочитай о баснях Эзопа.
steps: Aesop was a writer of ancient Greece. He wrote short stories — fables. They are very much like Krylov's fables. The fables end with a moral.
problems.answer: Aesop — ancient Greek fables with a moral

problems.condition: Unit 1, Step 10, упр. 2, с. 46. Прочитай басню «Кузнечик и муравей»: какая мораль подходит?
steps: The best moral is number 4: work today and you will have food tomorrow.
problems.answer: moral 4

problems.condition: Unit 1, Step 10, упр. 3, с. 48. Кто это сказал — муравей или кузнечик?
steps: Ant: «I'm collecting food for the winter». «I worked all summer to collect food». «And what did you do?» «If you dance and play all summer, you'll have no food in winter.» Grasshopper: «Why do you work on such a lovely day?»
problems.answer: ant — работал, собирал еду; grasshopper — играл

problems.condition: Unit 1, Step 10, упр. 4, с. 48. Какая басня Крылова похожа на эту?
steps: The most famous Russian writer of fables is Ivan Krylov. His fable «The Dragonfly and the Ant» has the same moral: work in summer to have food in winter.
problems.answer: Krylov — «Стрекоза и Муравей»

problems.condition: Unit 1, Step 10, упр. 5, с. 48. Прочитай стихотворение «Bed in Summer» и ответь.
steps: In summer it is easier to get up because it gets light early. In winter it is easier to go to bed because it gets dark early. The boy doesn't like going to bed in summer when it's still light.
problems.answer: summer — easy to get up; winter — easy to go to bed

problems.condition: Unit 1, Step 10, упр. 6, с. 49. Прочитай песню «The Ants Go Marching».
steps: Песня о муравьях, которые идут маршем по одному, по двое, по трое — и каждый раз маленький муравей останавливается, чтобы завязать шнурок, забраться на дерево, закрыть дверь.
problems.answer: The ants go marching one by one, two by two…
